guidance.title: Imagery guidance
guidance.do: Do: one light source, deep shadows, a muted cool grade that sits with Aubergine, and generous negative space for type. Themes: structure (architecture, stairs, junctions, cut sections), process (real work in progress, natural light, unposed) and material (layered surfaces up close).
guidance.avoid: Avoid: glowing brains, robots, holograms, neon networks, literal roots and trees, and generic office stock.
guidance.logo: Never place the logo inside an image — it is always overlaid from the SVG.
